## Summary

Financial claims and recommendations below are attributed to this September 25, 2026 report and its supplied September 24 technical snapshot. They are preserved historical claims, forecasts and conditions, not current market facts.[^hrta-e2f2954f5612304b]

Rank 1 is No actionable strategy due to provisional calendar, missing exact close, weak participation and failing reward-to-risk. Rank 2 rejects the 2,260–2,310 pullback/retest. Its hypothetical new-bar test requires volume ratio at least 0.9123, rising OBV/ADL and CMF no worse than −0.0483. These conditions are proposed, not observed. The sole 2,070 closing structural limit is too wide for the Moderate five-session setup and no tighter stop is invented. At best entry 2,260, ratios are 0.58:1 to 2,370, 0.79:1 to 2,410 and 1.11:1 to 2,470; all fail. The trigger deadline is session 3, September 30; a hypothetical qualifying plan would require 2,370 follow-through by holding-session 3. Placement/gold-market news and deterioration cancel the candidate.[^hrta-e2f2954f5612304b]

The report keeps signals separate from fills: Waiting is the stated cut-off condition; Armed/Triggered need fresh dated observations, Active needs explicit entry execution, and Completed needs fills closing the full position. Target touches or exit deadlines alone do not prove execution. Terminal scenario probabilities cannot establish conditional target/stop/fill probabilities, so strategy expected value is not reliably estimable. Unknown costs are not zero and capital, currency-risk, lot and execution inputs do not support a share quantity.[^hrta-e2f2954f5612304b]
